meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码提交与改动内容做成一段可分享的讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把 PR 里的改动讲给同事、用户或社区听,却不想自己录屏剪辑。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a code change into a narrated explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain code changes on video but don't want to record and edit.

howto.what: 给它一个 GitHub PR(链接或 owner/repo#N),它读取 diff、commit 和文件,依次产出分镜、脚本、配音,再逐帧渲染成讲解这段代码改动的视频,成品是 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你要把一个 GitHub PR(PR 链接、“owner/repo#N”,或当前仓库里的 this PR)做成代码改动讲解视频时接管;意图不清或不是 PR 时先去 /hyperframes。

say.text: 用当前仓库的 this PR 生成一支修复讲解视频
say.note: 自动定位当前分支对应的 PR

say.text: 这条 PR 的视频旁白用男声
say.note: 需在生成旁白时指定对应 voice id

howto.what_en: Given a GitHub PR (URL or owner/repo#N), it reads the diff, commits and files, plans a storyboard and script, generates narration, and renders a code-change explainer video frame by frame; output is renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a GitHub PR — a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or "this PR" in a checked-out repo — turned into a code-change explainer video. Unclear intent or no PR goes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into an explainer video: https://github.com/acme/sdk/pull/1842
say_en.note: Reads the PR's diff and plans the storyboard

say_en.text: Make a fix explainer video from this PR in the current repo
say_en.note: Resolves the current branch's PR automatically

say_en.text: Use a male voice for this PR video's narration
say_en.note: Pick a matching voice id when generating narration
